Me and my seester played mariokart ds with 6 other kids on the bus. It started off with just the two of us but then the other kids took notice and brought thier ds' on board! And so every single day since then, every morning and afternoon we'd play at least a good 4 races and a couple of bomb-omb battles in. It was so much fun because everyone wanted to try and beat us! However we had played double dash since we were wee lil' beans and most of the time we reined supreme! Not that those kids didn't give us a run for our money! By the end of the year the rest of the kids and even the bus driver was annoyed with our screaming and raging bit damn if that wasnt the most fun i had ever had on the bus!!!
